_notes: British spelling and curly quotes/apostrophes throughout (practise as a verb, practice as a noun; mums; Fill in the gaps).
«Готові уроки» = “Ready-made lessons” everywhere (heading “Ready-made Swedish lessons”, button “All ready-made lessons”).
«Медіатека» is treated as the proper name of a site section: “Media Library”, capitalised also mid-sentence (“Go to the Media Library”), like the Ukrainian capital М.
Teacher course title uses the official English edition: “[Don’t] call me “Miss”” (curly quotes).

Course names: “Swedish A1–A2”, “Swedish B1–B2”, “Vocabulary C1”, “103 Swedish verbs/adjectives/nouns” (matching the 103 SVENSKA … book series), “Swedish word bank” for «Скарбничка шведських слів» (use “word bank” for «скарбничка» in descriptions too), “Cheat sheet for mums”.

Live formats: «Індивідуальні заняття» = “One-to-one lessons” (badge “One-to-one”), «Парні заняття» = “Lessons in pairs”, «Абонемент» = “Package” (so «Абонемент на 5, 10 або 20 занять» → “Packages of 5, 10 or 20 lessons”).
Buttons are short verb phrases: Sign up, Choose a course, Find out more, Buy, Message Maria, Show answer, Read →.

Lesson-plan step names are standard EFL activity labels: Warm-up, Sorting, Reading, True or false, Vocabulary, Fill in the gaps, Choose the right form, Word order, Project, Discussion, Writing, Ranking.
«Вдома»/«вдома» in the lesson plan = “At home”/“at home” (homework section and its time column); «{n} хв» = “{n} min”; «{time} читання» = “{time} read” (e.g. “6 min read”).
Ukrainian «—» in short labels becomes a spaced en dash “ – ” (e.g. “Fika med Maria – home”). The accent article title gets a question mark, since English needs it for a yes/no question.
Slide image labels are English noun phrases parallel to “Title slide”: “Grammar slide”, “Project slide”, “Ranking slide”, “Vocabulary slide” (not “Slide: grammar”).
«презентація» = “presentation” everywhere (“Canva presentation”, “The lesson as a presentation”); «слайди» = “slides”. Do not mix in “slide deck”.

«заняття» and «урок» are both “lesson” (“One-to-one lessons”, “for online lessons”, “What happens in the lesson”); use “class” only for the teacher’s own class («для твого заняття» → “for your class”).
«Питання про: {title}» = “Question about {title}” – no colon after a preposition in English.
Testimonial sources: “YouTube comment”, “Instagram message”, “Reply to an Instagram story” (Instagram’s own word for a text answer to a story).
Form confirmation keeps the source’s strength: «найближчим часом» = “soon” (“I’ll be in touch soon”), not “very soon”.
